summary: safeGit now returns an object with code, stdout and stderr instead of a stdout string. A failing git command no longer throws, and the GitResult type is exported.

findings.title: safeGit return type changed but callers were not updated
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object and never throws. The callers in packages/cli/src/branch.ts and packages/cli/src/status.ts still treat the result as a string and rely on a throw.
findings.consequence: In branch.ts, currentBranch calls trim on an object, so the CLI always reports "not a git repository". In status.ts, changedFiles throws a TypeError on split, and tsc rejects the cli package.
findings.fix: Update currentBranch to return null when code is nonzero and to trim stdout otherwise. Update changedFiles to check code and split stdout.

findings.title: New error path in safeGit has no covering test
findings.problem: This change adds a catch branch that maps a git failure to a nonzero code. No test in the repository exercises safeGit.
findings.consequence: A test would have caught the broken callers. Future changes to the code mapping can also regress unnoticed.
findings.fix: Add tests for a successful git command and a failing one. Each test should assert code, stdout and stderr.
